name: pragma
description: Make AI-native ways of working reusable and help more people become AI super individuals.

scripts.test:revision: turbo run build --filter="@pragma/desktop^..." && pnpm --filter @pragma/built-in-agents exec vitest run test/pragma-management-tools.test.ts && pnpm --filter @pragma/desktop exec vitest run src/main/features/context-stores/knowledge-revision-capability.test.ts src/main/features/context-stores/context-store-revision-service.test.ts && pnpm --filter @pragma/desktop exec vitest run src/main/features/missions/mission-runner.test.ts -t "unmounted target|edits multiple drafts|managed knowledge draft|revision claim"
scripts.check: pnpm runtime:features:check && pnpm dsl:versions:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:core
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && pnpm cache:clean && rm -rf node_modules
scripts.test:mission-chat: turbo run build --filter="@pragma/desktop^..." && pnpm --filter @pragma/core exec vitest run test/runtime-stream-controller.test.ts -t "settles oversized" && pnpm --filter @pragma/memory exec vitest run test/retrieval.test.ts -t "preserves oversized" && pnpm --filter @pragma/desktop test:mission-chat
scripts.test:mission-control: turbo run build --filter="@pragma/desktop^..." && pnpm --filter @pragma/local-host exec vitest run test/mission-command-contract.test.ts test/mission-command-admission.test.ts test/mission-execution-owner.test.ts test/core-control-adapter.test.ts test/mission-control.test.ts test/mission-controller-store.test.ts test/owner-scope.test.ts test/core-run.test.ts test/queue-steer-crash.test.ts test/strict-steer-fallback-crash.test.ts test/core-human-response.test.ts test/core-control-retained-owner.test.ts test/core-control-real-boundary.test.ts && pnpm --filter @pragma/local-host exec vitest run test/execution-system.test.ts -t "atomically rejects a changed strict target|replays accepted .* steer after its target ends|finishes queued steer source cancellation on same-Session receipt replay|waitForPromptProcessing" && pnpm --filter @pragma/desktop exec vitest run src/main/features/missions/mission-runner.test.ts -t "forwards a durable"
scripts.test:mission-compilation: turbo run build --filter="@pragma/desktop^..." && pnpm --filter @pragma/local-host exec vitest run test/mission-compile-service.test.ts test/mission-compile-readiness.test.ts test/node-mission-compiler-errors.test.ts test/node-compilation-execution.test.ts test/core-control-compilation-authority.test.ts test/node-external-system-compilation.test.ts test/project-catalog.test.ts test/built-in-executors.test.ts test/project-revision.test.ts test/resource-resolvers.test.ts test/node-application.test.ts && pnpm --filter @pragma/desktop exec vitest run src/main/features/runtimes/runtime-availability.test.ts src/main/features/missions/mission-adapter-host.test.ts src/main/features/missions/mission-runner-external-system.test.ts
